notes.title: Death of the Reprobate 'Coming Soon'!
notes.content:
Huzzah!

Death of the Reprobate - the third and final instalment of the Immortal John Triptych – is coming to Steam. Find out more and view the new teaser trailer (and don't forget to hit the wishlist button!) here -

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1739900/Death_of_the_Reprobate/

:)

notes.title: 1.3.0 Build Notes / Early St Swithin's Day Sale
notes.content:
Hello!

I've released an update to fix a few small bugs/spelling errors, and add a few new (completely insignificant) features.

IMPORTANT: Due to issues with the engine I'm using, save files from previous builds will not work after the update. To prevent loss of progress I have disabled automatic updates.

Build Notes:

Minor bug fixed
Miner speling fixs :p
Slight audio balancing tweaks
Timings tweaked on time-based puzzles
Dialogues in Chief Clerk's Office tweaked
New hotspot 'Clouds' added to Tower Top scene
Hand + Musicians = Clapping

Furthermore,

T'is but 2.3 months until St Swithin's Day, and I can't contain my excitement any longer! To celebrate the approach of this great occasion Four Last Things will be 30% off until the end of the week.

Happy sinning!

Off you pop!

Joe
